title: Integrated Genomic, Functional and Prognostic Characterization of atypical Chronic Myeloid Leukemia
description: Atypical chronic myeloid leukemia (aCML) is a rare BCR-ABL1 negative clonal disorder, which belongs to the myelodysplastic/myeloproliferative group. This disease is characterized by recurrent somatic mutations in SETBP1, ASXL1 and ETNK1 genes, as well as high genetic heterogeneity, thus posing a great therapeutic challenge. With the aim to provide a comprehensive genomic characterization of aCML we applied a high-throughput sequencing strategy to 43 aCML samples, including both whole-exome and RNA-sequencing data.
